existing_behavior: Documented linked filtering; concrete renderer paths vary. Unsized scatter discrepancy described in report.
proposed_behavior: Immediate logical mark selection/filter, without a double-click waiting window.
priority_conflict_rule: One primary sequence has one owner; no prior edit-selection click.
keyboard_alternative: Existing mark activation where supported; chart Filters tab
change_rationale: Protect the higher user priority.

existing_behavior: onSelectPoint resolves row and toggles __ID filter.
proposed_behavior: Keep exact record filtering.
priority_conflict_rule: No menu or toolbar activation on this gesture.
change_rationale: Working point interaction must remain intact.

existing_behavior: ScatterSvg early return skips ordinary onSelectPoint; brush onPlotClick only handles Alt or size. Static discrepancy, not runtime-tested.
proposed_behavior: Make row filtering meet the stated contract before adopting new controls.
priority_conflict_rule: Treat as baseline defect candidate, not permission for edit-mode click.
keyboard_alternative: Header/Filters fallback until actual mark navigation is implemented
change_rationale: Preserve intent rather than canonizing an inconsistent event path.

existing_behavior: ColorScale/ChartColorLegend toggle category filter.
proposed_behavior: Keep entire chip filtering.
priority_conflict_rule: Separate explicit configure control or right-click; no swatch click hijack.
change_rationale: Do not import a conflicting Grafana convention.

existing_behavior: Clears this chart filters through chart-specific dead-click handlers.
proposed_behavior: Keep clear-this-chart, only outside owned controls/marks.
priority_conflict_rule: No synthetic clear following menu dismissal or drag.
scope: Chart selection, not all workspace filters
change_rationale: Maintains the clear path.

existing_behavior: Brush draw/move/resize; capture begins after a movement threshold.
proposed_behavior: Keep brushing and one completed selection action.
priority_conflict_rule: No click action after drag; pointercancel cancels transient gesture.
touch_alternative: Existing touch brush only where deliberate; visible filter controls otherwise
change_rationale: Configuration must not introduce arbitrary plot zoom.

existing_behavior: Unhandled chart context menu falls back to image export; more-specific objects may handle it.
proposed_behavior: Shallow chart section with Color by…; optional distinct record trace section; export footer.
priority_conflict_rule: Resolve current logical target, prevent default once, never emit a preceding filter click.
scope: Chart binding versus record trace labeled separately
keyboard_alternative: Focused chart menu key/Shift+F10; visible Color
change_rationale: Shortens route locally without changing primary gesture.

existing_behavior: Current Alt path traces point/guide/overlay.
proposed_behavior: Experimental favored route opens Color search; supported targets later map to their compact editor.
priority_conflict_rule: Arm on pointerdown; no filter; accept only stationary release; no browser guarantee.
keyboard_alternative: Visible Color → Enter; keyboard context menu
change_rationale: Reallocate modifier to repeated configuration, subject to proof.

existing_behavior: Alt goes into useBrush pointer path; moved sequence can brush, even though click trace is suppressed.
proposed_behavior: Experimental remap cancels with no edit, trace or filter; use plain drag to brush.
priority_conflict_rule: Movement cancels configuration sequence and suppresses its trailing click.
keyboard_alternative: Filters tab or plain pointer drag
change_rationale: Explicitly changes an existing incidental Alt-brush path.

existing_behavior: Two ordinary input sequences may reach existing handlers; no universal edit action established.
proposed_behavior: No new double-click edit behavior on selectable marks.
priority_conflict_rule: Do not delay first click; preserve existing per-family semantics.
change_rationale: Avoid filter-then-edit accidents.

existing_behavior: Table/title preserve browser access; panel checks Shift after axis delegation, so axes can intercept.
proposed_behavior: Early browser-menu bypass before all application object delegation.
priority_conflict_rule: Pointer modifier bypass only; do not apply it to Shift+F10.
keyboard_alternative: Native keyboard browser menu remains platform dependent
change_rationale: Fix inconsistent bypass.

existing_behavior: Composition quick menu and table-related routes have keyboard access; not universal.
proposed_behavior: Open same scoped menu at focused object bounds; chart root gets chart menu.
priority_conflict_rule: Keyboard-origin flag wins over pointer Shift bypass; one menu only.
change_rationale: Avoid requiring pointer coordinates.

target: Chart title in grid drag handle
existing_behavior: useTitleEditing handles second mousedown because grid may swallow click/dblclick.
proposed_behavior: Keep press-level inline rename.
priority_conflict_rule: Stop grid drag; editor marked data-inplace-editor.
change_rationale: A naive dblclick refactor would regress delivered behavior.

existing_behavior: Opens inline title editor.
proposed_behavior: Keep; do not repurpose Enter to a command palette.
priority_conflict_rule: Text-editing keys first.
change_rationale: Use established accessible route.

existing_behavior: Moves chart in wide grid.
proposed_behavior: Keep outside an active editor; no saved layout mutation in narrow flow.
priority_conflict_rule: Editor and configuration presses cancel grid drag.
keyboard_alternative: Existing layout controls; keyboard move not established in packet
touch_alternative: Narrow flow has no saved drag
change_rationale: Local control must not accidentally rearrange workspace.

existing_behavior: Current copy and handlers commonly trace these objects.
proposed_behavior: If remap ships, configure supported object; trace via scoped menu and header browser.
priority_conflict_rule: No production mixture of undocumented old/new Alt meanings; implement replacement access first.
keyboard_alternative: Menu key; explicit action; trace browser
change_rationale: User allowed a coherent convention change.

gesture: Command-primary click; Ctrl-primary on eligible non-Mac systems
existing_behavior: AxisFieldActions inspects field.
proposed_behavior: Keep Command inspection; treat macOS Control-click as OS context menu, not primary inspect.
priority_conflict_rule: OS context gesture precedes generic modifier interpretation.
keyboard_alternative: Ctrl/Meta-Enter as supported; menu Inspect field
change_rationale: Preserve useful inspection without pretending modifiers are portable.

existing_behavior: Field inspection/create/copy and axis-edit items where supplied.
proposed_behavior: Add separate Change field…; retain Rename and Set range where eligible.
priority_conflict_rule: Map data-field label/tick to correct axis band; do not change scope based on accidental child target.
scope: Axis binding or title explicitly named
change_rationale: Three distinct tasks deserve distinct verbs.

existing_behavior: Local range editor via useAxisEditing.
proposed_behavior: Keep exact bounds editor.
priority_conflict_rule: Axis-owned gesture does not brush.
change_rationale: Existing efficient local operation.

existing_behavior: Pan body/stretch endpoint using axisDrag.
proposed_behavior: Keep, with explicit drag cancellation.
priority_conflict_rule: Axis drag wins over plot brush; one undo checkpoint.
change_rationale: Direct manipulation is appropriate on an unambiguous ruler.

existing_behavior: Opens reason/count and reset; excludes brush handling.
proposed_behavior: Keep visible remedy.
priority_conflict_rule: Owned control before axis/plot hit areas.
scope: One axis bound or log omission
change_rationale: Density must not obscure omitted-data explanations.

existing_behavior: Plain title usually has no config; Alt traces scale.
proposed_behavior: Change color field opens same chart picker.
priority_conflict_rule: Must not overlap category chip or imply shared palette mutation.
change_rationale: Use visible semantics without stealing filtering.

existing_behavior: Usually panel export fallback unless specialized parent.
proposed_behavior: Edit shared colors… with owner and affected charts.
priority_conflict_rule: Keep whole chip primary filter; distinct menu action.
change_rationale: Local entry requires shared-state warning.

existing_behavior: Alt can trace; normal category toggle does not apply.
proposed_behavior: Edit shared scale…; numeric domain and palette stay in existing editor.
priority_conflict_rule: No conflation with x/y bounds or density count maxima.
change_rationale: Scope is more important than a clever shortcut.

existing_behavior: Existing ComboBox filters options by display string; selection invokes onChange.
proposed_behavior: Search both label and ID; navigation is not preview mutation.
priority_conflict_rule: Native text keys first; stable unique option identity.
change_rationale: Supports many fields without accidental saves.

existing_behavior: onChange and close; scale creation can occur in settings handler.
proposed_behavior: Resolve/create scale and bind chart in one held discrete transaction; close.
priority_conflict_rule: Hold before scale creation; same-field no-op emits no checkpoint.
scope: Chart binding plus possibly new shared scale
change_rationale: No orphan scale or two-step undo.

existing_behavior: Layer behavior varies; existing root Escape may clear brush or close details.
proposed_behavior: Cancel innermost search/menu first, stop propagation, return focus.
priority_conflict_rule: One Escape does not also clear chart selection or close details.
change_rationale: Protect context and selection.

existing_behavior: useChartEdit supports apply/commit/cancel and unmount finish.
proposed_behavior: Preview valid values; group one session; explicit cancel restores only owned keys.
priority_conflict_rule: Finish before unrelated chart action; no global snapshot rollback.
change_rationale: Avoid one history step per keystroke.

existing_behavior: Not independently runtime-verified; portal library behavior must be tested.
proposed_behavior: Dismiss and consume that same sequence; next independent ordinary click filters normally.
priority_conflict_rule: No dismissal click-through; no timer delaying ordinary resting clicks.
change_rationale: Prevents an unexpected filter while leaving an editor.

existing_behavior: Not established for proposed menu.
proposed_behavior: Close stale editor; preserve accepted state; return focus to surviving chart/header/workspace control.
priority_conflict_rule: Never retarget by old pixels to a different logical record.
change_rationale: Logical target identity must outlive neither chart nor source revision.

existing_behavior: Axis editor uses dialog portal container; details Escape yields to nested layers.
proposed_behavior: Reuse dialog-aware portal, scoped Escape and focus return.
priority_conflict_rule: Modal focus trap must not eject field search.
change_rationale: A working grid popup can otherwise fail in details.

existing_behavior: Trace and field/header behaviors; Facets settings owns configuration.
proposed_behavior: Offer chart-wide facet fields/order with All panels owner caption.
priority_conflict_rule: No per-facet binding inferred from clicked header.
change_rationale: Avoid local-looking global template mistake.

existing_behavior: Documented callout label movement with one edit and Escape.
proposed_behavior: Keep label movement, not source-record movement.
priority_conflict_rule: Annotation handle wins over brush and menu background.
touch_alternative: Dedicated handle with adequate hit size
change_rationale: Preserve stable record anchor.

existing_behavior: Notes tab owns annotations; no generic mark menu addition established.
proposed_behavior: Deep-link to matching existing note controls; later one-shot placement only.
priority_conflict_rule: Never convert an ordinary filter click into annotation selection.
change_rationale: Useful local creation without a sticky editing mode.

existing_behavior: Sorts table rows locally.
proposed_behavior: Keep sort and reverse.
priority_conflict_rule: Heading is not a row-selection mark.
change_rationale: Do not apply chart-mark rules mechanically.

existing_behavior: Filter/sort/move/hide/copy; cell value actions.
proposed_behavior: Keep existing commands, extend only missing scoped access.
priority_conflict_rule: Specific table menu owns event; browser bypass; export remains chart menu requirement.
scope: Column/cell; local sort versus linked filter
change_rationale: Reusing established density beats another framework.

existing_behavior: Reorder or hide column, documented.
proposed_behavior: Keep; menu move/hide alternatives remain.
priority_conflict_rule: No chart-grid drag from table header.
change_rationale: Drag convenience must not be required.

existing_behavior: Per-series settings exist; a uniform legend config gesture not established.
proposed_behavior: Open named series style/right-axis editor after proof.
priority_conflict_rule: Visual hide/isolate does not replace linked filtering.
change_rationale: Only target properties that actually have series scope.

existing_behavior: Map has geographic navigation and saved view; layers already local.
proposed_behavior: Retain navigation; no scatter brush/config rule globally attached.
priority_conflict_rule: Renderer-specific navigation precedes generic background handlers.
change_rationale: Avoid a broad renderer gesture rewrite.

existing_behavior: Quick menu navigates mark, scale, unit, repeat, trace and editing actions.
proposed_behavior: Keep hierarchy and reuse intent-aware navigation, not generic replacement.
priority_conflict_rule: Editing element selection is explicit; viewing repeat selection remains linked.
change_rationale: This family already solves nested targets differently.

target: New Color control on narrow screen
existing_behavior: Proposed control absent; grid flows below960 without saved rearrangement.
proposed_behavior: 1280 anchored popup;783 collision-aware popup;390 compact lower sheet with chart context retained.
priority_conflict_rule: Clamp to visual viewport; no hidden accept/close; portal-safe; do not mutate saved layout.
change_rationale: Density includes reachability, not tiny controls.

existing_behavior: No general configuration long-press established; ScatterSvg touch-action none is an existing collision.
proposed_behavior: Not required in first proof. Later optional context access only if scroll/pointercancel remain correct.
priority_conflict_rule: Visible tap path first; never wait for long press to decide touch-action.
change_rationale: Avoid accidental edits and scroll capture.

gesture: S / E / Shift+E / C and existing shortcuts
existing_behavior: Hover/focus shortcuts open settings, export or clear as applicable.
proposed_behavior: Keep existing shortcuts, suppress while typing or inside editor/menu.
priority_conflict_rule: Native input and focused editor consume keys before panel shortcut.
change_rationale: No new global letter palette needed.

existing_behavior: UI defaults say charts and editing tools take no input in read-only previews.
proposed_behavior: Keep read-only guard before local configuration and filtering mutations.
priority_conflict_rule: Owner host/read-only policy wins.
change_rationale: Research read-only is not a request to alter product read-only policy.
